## Notes

The transcript begins "Seal: intact. No record changed after the end of the test." The audit reports no breaks, errors or blocked calls, and findings.json contains no findings.

Checked all three turns against the copied app spec and rules, the tool and backend results, app.py, entry.py, services.py, stock.py and toy_model.py. Read the current state.json and stock.json without starting the app or sending it a message. The stock values match the recorded results, and order 6210 remains "waiting for stock". The app saved a case note for each turn. No app-state files or tester notes were available. Current project state is corroboration, not a sealed snapshot of test-time state.

The app checked the requested stock SKUs and looked up the requested order. The replies match those results. Turn 3's availability statement has support in the earlier teapot stock result. No reservation was requested or claimed as completed. Required stock backend and model API trace points appear in the record; the order lookup appears in the model session. No other issue was established by this test. Returns, refunds, reservations, another customer's order and unrelated topics were not exercised.

Checked both limits for every turn. Durations were 3.016, 62.47 and 4.256 seconds against a 30-second limit. Model sessions together used 82, 169 and 180 output tokens against a 2000-token limit. All required limit values were known. Missing usage for direct model API calls does not prevent checking the specified model-session token limit.
